Description

Boxsubmus is a small and independent video game studio dedicated to developing quality software and video games.

History

Before

Starpelly and Allyway each spent years pursuing their own creative work before joining forces to found Boxsubmus in June 2021. Starpelly created and led development on Heaven Studio for roughly two years before retiring away from the project, while Allyway has been drawing consistently for nearly eight years. Together, they set out to combine their talents in service of a noble goal: their secret dream game. It hasn't materialized yet, but who knows what the future holds.
